description:
***ENQUIRES THROUGH DAFT.IE ONLY, DO NOT CALL THE OFFICE OR CONTACT THE AGENT DIRECTLY***

***Please include a short bio about yourself with your enquiry***


Stunning, luxury 2 double bedroom 2 bathroom apartment in the heart of Cork City with a car space included in a private underground car park.

This beautifully maintained building is a striking example of Art Nouveau architecture, complete with elegant mosaic tiling above the main entrance. Step into a welcoming double-height lobby, served by two high-speed lifts that swiftly bring you to your floor. Here, apartments are arranged around a bright, airy atrium with stylish, modern décor throughout.

Inside the apartment, the open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area offers a seamless flow through to a spacious private terrace — the perfect retreat after a busy day. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with high-gloss cabinetry, integrated appliances, and quality tiled flooring, while the dining and living areas feature semi-solid wood floors and floor-to-ceiling glass doors that flood the space with natural light.

The hallway leads to two generous double bedrooms, both beautifully finished with fully fitted wardrobes. The master bedroom benefits from a sleek ensuite bathroom, while the main bathroom mirrors a five-star hotel in style and finish. A standout feature is the large laundry/storage room, offering excellent additional space rarely found in apartment living.

This is a superb opportunity to live in a stylish, modern apartment in the heart of the city, with all amenities and transport links right on your doorstep.
